hold_reason: Refund discrepancy: W2 (Alpha Co) reported order 203 refund of 18687 cents as applied, but list_refunds shows only orders 201 and 204. net_balance(acme) returned 73072, which equals gross orders 200+203 (39447+33625) with no deduction for order 203, so acme would be overpaid by 18687 cents. Payouts are irreversible, so the batch needs human review to confirm the order 203 refund before any payouts are recorded.
